top_signals.title: NHL’s Billionaire Samueli Family Strikes $100 Million-Plus Deal for Anaheim Museum
top_signals.summary: OCVIBE CEO Bill Foltz discusses the Samueli family-backed, 100-acre development in Anaheim and its more than $100 million deal with digital art collective teamLab to open its first permanent US location. Foltz and teamLab Communications Director Takashi Kudo say the project hopes to draw some of the millions of visitors who head to nearby Disneyland each year. They speak to Bloomberg's Norah Mulinda.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Monte Paschi Investors Reject Banco BPM Bid in Win For Intesa
top_signals.summary: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA’s investors rejected a €25 billion ($27.9 billion) plan to acquire Banco BPM SpA, dealing a major setback to Chief Executive Officer Luigi Lovaglio’s effort to fend off a takeover bid from Intesa Sanpaolo SpA.
